## Where things stand

**Implemented and verified** (counted): Git setup, Claude Code harness, shared tracking, Expo scaffold, lint/test tooling, shared workflow skills and design tokens. These are foundation/design-system outcomes; no end-to-end workout feature has been verified.

**Exists but not counted** (drafts, in review, or failing verification):

| Item | Task | Why it does not count yet |
|---|---|---|
| UI primitives (`src/components/ui.tsx`) | DS-02 | Strict typecheck, lint and six RNTL tests pass. Native device, screenshot and accessibility checks remain. |
| Home and Active Workout screens, preview harness (`src/features/**`) | HST-06, WKT-07, FND-14 | Pre-milestone drafts backed by mock data; unverified |

**Remaining:** NativeWind (FND-08), native review of primitives, the restyle to the approved light look (DEC-020), the exercise services and hooks (EXL-02 to EXL-05), and the remaining feature milestones.

## How this file is maintained

- The block between the `tracker:begin/end` markers is regenerated by `node scripts/tracker.mjs --write` after any change to `docs/FEATURE_TRACKER.md`. `--check` fails if it is stale, and Claude Code's Stop hook runs that check automatically.
- Whichever agent finishes a meaningful piece of work updates the sections above. Verified changes go to `CHANGELOG.md`, decisions to `DECISIONS.md`, and cross-agent requests to `HANDOFFS.md`.
